page.layout: Running head at top left and page number at top right. One column of main text, with marginal notes in the right margin beside the first lines. Below the text, a gathering signature at the lower left.

main_text.head: Periodus III.
main_text.p: Inde Anglia ad NormannosEt non multò post Nor-manni venit.
A.C. 1066. Wilhelmus Normanniæ Dux Angliam cruentâ victoriâ subjugavit, & dictus propterea Conquestor. Hæc Normannica invasio & lingvam, & mores & leges Anglorum vehementer mutavit.
A.C. 117ʒ[?] Rege Heinrico II. Causa fuit raptus, quem Dermitius Rex Lagenia commiserat. Hâc oc-casione evocati in Hyberniam Angli universam Insulam debellarunt.
Factiones Lancastrensium & Eboracensium gravissimè affi-xerunt Angliam.

page.notes: The marginal notes are set in small type. The right-margin note at the first paragraph reads "Et non multò post Normanni", broken over several lines as Nor-/manni. The second right-margin note reads "Angliæ accedit Hyber-nia", and its last word "&" is on the line of "Heinrico II.". The year "117ʒ" is a reading of an old form of the final numeral; it is probably 1172 but is marked doubtful. The gathering signature at the foot is partly faint; "E ij." is doubtful. The long s is transcribed as plain s throughout.
